March 25

The Annunciation

By Father John Banister Tabb (1845–1909)

“F
IAT!”
—The flaming word
Flashed, as the brooding Bird
Uttered the doom far heard
Of Death and Night.
“Fiat!”—A cloistered womb—
A sealed, untainted tomb—
Wakes to the birth and bloom
Of Life and Light.
